newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Foreign projects in Argentina said to be $12.3 bln.
newsitem.headline: Foreign projects in Argentina said to be $12.3 bln.

text.p: Foreign investors plan projects in Argentina worth $12.3 billion in the period 1997-2000, private consultants Fundacion Invertir said Friday.
Fundacion Invertir said foreign companies had concrete plans to invest $6.3 billion in 1997, $2.6 billion in 1998, $1.8 billion in 1999 and $1.7 billion in 2000.
This year, U.S. firms plan projects worth $1.7 billion, Spanish firms plan $1.6 billion, and British companies plan $928 million, it said.
Sectors attracting the most interest are banking and insurance, energy, telecommunications, cars, and gas and oil.
